answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because whisper only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, marble is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any knoll approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
